name: mysites-guru
title: MySites.guru
description: Search and manage your mySites.guru connected sites
author: PhilETaylor

commands.name: search-sites
commands.title: Site Search
commands.description: Search, inspect, and manage your mySites.guru sites

commands.name: run-audit
commands.title: Run Site Audit
commands.description: Find a site and queue a security audit

commands.name: create-backup
commands.title: Create Site Backup
commands.description: Find a site and queue a backup

commands.name: take-snapshot
commands.title: Take Site Snapshot
commands.description: Find a site and queue a file snapshot

commands.name: at-risk-sites
commands.title: At-Risk Sites
commands.description: Review sites that need attention and queue bulk actions

commands.name: portfolio-summary
commands.title: Copy Portfolio Summary
commands.description: Copy an account-wide health summary to the clipboard

commands.name: portfolio-monitor
commands.title: Portfolio Monitor
commands.description: Show sites needing attention in the menu bar

preferences.name: notifyNewIssues
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.label: Show a macOS notification when a site newly needs attention
preferences.description: Sends a macOS notification (via osascript) for newly detected issues. The menu bar always highlights new issues regardless of this setting.

commands.name: sign-out
commands.title: Sign Out
commands.description: Remove the stored MySites.guru OAuth session

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: OAuth Client ID
preferences.description: Client ID from your MySites.guru API client registration

preferences.name: listSiteAction
preferences.title: List: CMD+Enter Action
preferences.description: Action when pressing Command+Enter on a site in the search list (Enter always opens the detail view)

preferences.name: primarySiteAction
preferences.title: Detail: Enter Action
preferences.description: Action when pressing Enter in the site detail view

preferences.name: secondarySiteAction
preferences.title: Detail: CMD+Enter Action
preferences.description: Action when pressing Command+Enter in the site detail view

preferences.name: confirmSiteActions
preferences.title: Confirm Actions
preferences.label: Ask for confirmation before queuing audits, backups, and snapshots
preferences.description: Show a confirmation prompt before queuing audits, backups, or snapshots

preferences.name: concernCompromise
preferences.title: Attention Signals
preferences.label: Potential compromise
preferences.description: Flag sites in the menu bar and At-Risk command when a compromise or malicious cron job is detected

preferences.name: concernVulnerabilities
preferences.label: Vulnerabilities
preferences.description: Flag sites with vulnerable extensions or core vulnerabilities

preferences.name: concernSsl
preferences.label: SSL expiring or expired
preferences.description: Flag sites whose SSL certificate is expiring soon or has expired

preferences.name: concernDisconnected
preferences.label: Disconnected
preferences.description: Flag sites that are not currently connected

preferences.name: concernCoreUpdates
preferences.label: Core version updates
preferences.description: Flag sites with a CMS core update available

preferences.name: concernUpdates
preferences.label: Any available updates
preferences.description: Flag sites with any available updates. Turn this off (while leaving core updates on) to hide routine plugin-update noise

preferences.name: concernConfig
preferences.label: Risky configuration
preferences.description: Flag sites with debug mode, offline mode, open registration, disabled caching, or admins without 2FA
